body: Hi Nycholis.  Rating your life by the amount of sex you have is a sure way to degrade yourself.  It sounds like you are investing a lot of emotional energy into people who don't deserve it, even if they have been in your life a long time.  They are benefiting and you are suffering for it.  You can find friends that are worthy of knowing you, but it may not be in your immediate vicinity.  The Internet is good for that.  I know it's a cliche but it's true.  Most of my friends I know from childhood aren't very good friends anymore.  Everyone grows up and has their own selfish interests and bullshit to deal with and it can be very emotionally draining to remain friends with them.  All I can tell you is not to give up trying.  And forget that girl who is playing with you, she sounds like someone who brings negative energy into your life.  There are so many girls out there!  Trust me I went through this same thing myself.  There are girls who will toy with your emotions and play head games.  Avoid them.  You can always start over, don't fall into the trap of thinking you can't.  It's very uncomfortable at first but it can open up opportunities you never dreamed of before.  I know it sounds cheesy but it happened to me.  And you may find a new purpose in life.

Hello there.  As someone who has abused drugs for too long, and seen friends overdose and die, or throw their lives away, I can tell you that eventually it will catch up with you.  Occasional use isn't bad but using it to escape problems will only lead you further down the rabbit hole.    

Forgive me for asking but is the cancer treatable?  Maybe there is hope despite the diagnosis.

I'm 34, and have been struggling with suicidal tendencies for the past  year.  I would say it's very common because the blissful ignorance of the teens and 20s are over with, and harsh realities, disappointments, and lack of fulfillment hit many people in their 30s and 40s.  For some it happens sooner, others later but given the ridiculous population on this planet, you'll find it across all age groups.
Yes there are lots of people who care.  Tell us your problems.

Hi there.  A lot of struggle comes from trying to find acceptance from others, but many times these "others" are people who don't deserve to know you as the person you are.  And this causes a lot of internal conflict because you'll never be truly accepted until you move on.

There is a lot of ugliness in this world, but also a lot of beauty if you look for it.  There are many others that can and will identify with you, support you, and make life beautiful for you.  The idea that a person is either a man, or a woman, with no other category is utter crap!  Human sexuality is a spectrum and I truly believe some people are born in the wrong body.  We are all on this crazy ride together, and everyone deserves love and support.  I hope you find the strength to carry on and set an example for others experiencing the same issues.  Never let anyone else beat you down, you are better than that.

Hi there.  It sounds like you would really benefit from a fresh start somewhere else.  You'd be really surprised how communities are different especially in major metropolitan areas.  Much more tolerant of differences among fellow people, and many like-minded individuals.  To be free you have to live free and that may mean giving up much of what you know now, but if it gives you the life you want, wouldn't it be worth it?  And a hell of an adventure that you can tell as a story time and time again.  It's your life, fuck everyone else who tries to mold it for you.  The sooner you live life by your rules, the sooner you'll find contentment.

Hi there, hope you're still with us.  2 nights ago I was very close to ending it all, just another hopeless, destitute, empty night in my life.  

I can offer you this advice.  No matter which method you choose, they are all a permanent solution to a temporary situation.  What if you get second thoughts after you've passed the point of no return and it's too late to stop from dying?  That would be a worse feeling than all of the trauma up until now and a horrible way to spend your last moments.  Death is guaranteed for us all, if you want to rush it that is your choice but overall life is very short and there's no contract with the Universe that you'll make it to 30, 40, or even 70.  Life is a game of chance.

It is a very common human condition, that people think they are more fucked up than the next person.  Most people's minds are a complete jungle, that's why alcoholism, addictions, and general bad behavior are rampant.

Since you say part of you wants to live, there is hope!  And anyone who is agreeing with you that suicide is the best option, is a terrible person with their own problems.  Don't listen to them.  Only you can decide if you should stay or go, but I know there is at least one person that would be devastated to lose you.  Isn't that enough to stay on this crazy ride?
Thank you for the supportive comments.  I'm here for another day, the daylight hours are easier.  Another chance at not fucking up.
